subject: Post-demo pricing: rough $/1M targets + per-model usage breakdown
summary: Post-demo follow-up capturing KyroSoft's expected token volumes, high-level budget range and a recommended per-model split (chat / embeddings / rerank). Next steps: confirm monthly 1M-token price target, share cost scenarios + small pilot SOW.
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Walsh <emma@kyrosoft.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo pricing: rough $/1M targets + per-model usage breakdown

Emma — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap while it's fresh and a couple of asks so we can size an accurate pilot SOW.

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: in-product assistant + semantic search for knowledge base and docs.
- Expected monthly active users (MAU): 120k, but usage is spiky (support hours).
- Typical session: 1–3 assistant exchanges (avg ~300 tokens in + 200 tokens out), plus an embedding lookup for top-5 docs per query.

Qual numbers you mentioned (please confirm):
- Avg queries/day: 60k–90k (we heard 75k as the working number)
- Target monthly token budget: ~1.2M–2.0M tokens/day (you said budget maps to roughly $200–$700k/year).

My preliminary ask: can you confirm the budget comfort at the $/1M-token level? You mentioned wanting a target of under $350 / 1M tokens for the pilot. If that holds we can prioritize a model mix that leans on a smaller context chat model + aggressive embedding efficiency.

Proposed per-model split (first-pass estimate):
- Chat (assistant): 40% of token volume — optimize for latency/cost with gpt-like chat variant (short context, ~500 tokens/session)
- Embeddings (search + rerank inputs): 50% of token-equivalent usage (we'll bill embeddings differently but converting to token-equivalent for unit economics)
- Rerank / 2-step reranking calls: 10% (higher-cost per request but low volume)

Next asks:
1) Confirm that $350 / 1M tokens is an acceptable target for the pilot (or give preferred target).
2) Share a short CSV with daily query distribution (peak hour multiplier). We attached a sample sheet to show the columns we need.

I'll loop Ben and Marissa on pricing scenarios once we get your confirmation.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Attachments referenced: KyroSoft_volume_estimates.xlsx (sample columns: date, queries, peak_multiplier, avg_prompt_tokens, avg_completion_tokens)

Date: 2027-10-31T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo pricing: rough $/1M targets + per-model usage breakdown

Thanks Jordan — quick confirmation from our side (see inline).

> My preliminary ask: can you confirm the budget comfort at the $/1M-token level? You mentioned wanting a target of under $350 / 1M tokens for the pilot.

Yes — $350 / 1M tokens is our upper bound for the 3-month pilot. If we can land around $250–$300 we can accelerate to a committed pilot.

> Proposed per-model split (first-pass estimate): Chat 40% / Embeddings 50% / Rerank 10%

That aligns with what we expect. More color: embeddings will be heavy during our nightly batch enrichment (adds to embedding usage) but day time search queries likely dominate token costs. Expect embeddings-heavy nights but overall split should end up ~45% embeddings / 45% chat / 10% rerank.

We'll upload a CSV with daily distributions by EOD tomorrow.

— Emma

Subject: RE: Post-demo pricing: rough $/1M targets + per-model usage breakdown (internal notes)

Quick internal pricing scenarios for KyroSoft given the confirmed $350 / 1M upper bound and expected split (we'll tighten after CSV).

Assumptions (working):
- Reference token definition = input+output tokens.
- Daily queries: 75k (avg) -> ~2.25M queries/month (30 days).
- Avg chat tokens per query: 700 tokens (prompt + completion aggregated).
- Avg embedding tokens per doc: embeddings are billed per embedding vector; we convert to token-eq for econ by using 1 embedding call ~ 200 token-equivalent.

Scenario A (cost-focused, lean models):
- Chat model: smaller chat-v1 (latency optimized) — $180 / 1M tokens equivalent
- Embeddings: compressed/embed-lite — $120 / 1M token-equivalent (converted)
- Rerank: on-demand rerank model — $450 / 1M tokens equivalent
- Weighted blended: (0.45*180 + 0.45*120 + 0.10*450) = ~$183 / 1M tokens

Scenario B (quality-focused, mixed family):
- Chat: chat-medium — $300 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: standard embed — $150 / 1M tokens
- Rerank: high-precision rerank — $600 / 1M tokens
- Blended: (0.45*300 + 0.45*150 + 0.10*600) = ~$289 / 1M tokens

Notes:
- At KyroSoft volume, we can meaningfully compress cost via batching, prefix caching for repeat queries, and nightly embedding dedupe. That could give us an additional ~10–20% unit improvement over list prices.
- If Emma's team can commit to a 6-month pilot with a 3-month ramp to steady state, we can push an introductory blended to under $250 / 1M tokens (targeted econ addendum in SOW).

Next internal steps: draft two pricing lines (A = conservative cost-first; B = quality-focused) with explicit assumptions and ask product to validate latency targets. I'll draft a customer-facing note once we get KyroSoft CSV.

— Ben

Subject: Pricing estimate and next steps (pilot options)

Emma / Carlos — thanks for confirming the $350 / 1M upper bound. Based on our conversation and Ben's scenarios, attached are two pilot options (sheet + short PDF):

Pilot Option 1 (cost-first, 3-month pilot)
- Blended target: ~$180 / 1M tokens (after batching & caching optimizations)
- Per-model approach: chat-compact (40%), embeddings-compressed (50%), rerank-light (10%)
- Commitment ask: 3 months, baseline monthly minimum (to be defined once we see CSV)

Pilot Option 2 (quality-first, 6-month pilot)
- Blended target: ~$260–290 / 1M tokens initial, ramping to ~$220 after operational optimizations
- Per-model approach: chat-medium + embeddings-standard + higher-precision reranker
- Commitment ask: 6 months with staged discounts after month 3

Requested next steps:
1) Upload the CSV (daily queries + peak multiplier) to the Drive link we shared (or just reply with CSV).
2) Confirm which pilot option you prefer; we'll turn the selected option into an SOW + pricing addendum.
3) If you're comfortable, sign the non-binding pilot terms we can send via DocuSign — we can include the econ addendum to secure the blended price.

I've attached: redwood-pricing-v2.pdf (line-item pricing + optimization levers) and KyroSoft_volume_estimates.xlsx (template). Also linking a provisional DocuSign URL for the pilot term sheet: https://docusign.com/redwood/kyrosoft-pilot (placeholder — live once we confirm).

Happy to jump on a 30 min call tomorrow to walk through the assumptions with Carlos and your engineering lead.

Thanks — Jordan
